name: pagedjs
description: Chunks up a document into paged media flows and applies print styles
author: Fred Chasen

scripts.specs: npm run build && npx playwright test --config specs/playwright.config.js
scripts.docker-test: docker build -t pagedmedia/pagedjs . && docker run --rm --ipc=host --user pwuser pagedmedia/pagedjs npm test
scripts.docker-specs: mkdir -p test-results && docker build -t pagedmedia/pagedjs . && docker run --rm --ipc=host --user pwuser -v "$(pwd)/test-results:/home/pwuser/pagedjs/test-results" pagedmedia/pagedjs npm run specs
scripts.docker-update-specs: mkdir -p test-results && docker build -t pagedmedia/pagedjs . && docker run --rm --ipc=host --user pwuser -v "$(pwd)/test-results:/home/pwuser/pagedjs/test-results" pagedmedia/pagedjs npm run specs -- --update-snapshots=all
